recommendation: Keep the audit commit as-is for FHIR-16607. Any broader cleanup of similar wording in other resources should be handled under a separate tracker because this issue specifically targeted Patient.communication.
issue_request: FHIR-16607 was a Published/Persuasive STU3 technical correction asking PA to fix the Patient Resource Detailed Descriptions page for Patient.communication, replacing the ungrammatical 'languages spoken and proficiency is an important things' wording. A Jira comment records the applied grammar as 'languages spoken and proficiency are important things to keep track of'.
initial_application: The fix appears to have been applied in fc7ea03932902e37102804891ea78bf466960584, 'GF#18322 - fix typo in Patient.communication.', which changed source/patient/patient-spreadsheet.xml from 'proficiency is an important things' to 'proficiency are important things'. The 2021 source rebuild in 33b409a4b6d544598262f2f074ebb4b6dc466157 carried that corrected wording into source/patient/structuredefinition-Patient.xml.
additional_context: source/fhir.ini lists patient as an active resource and assigns it to the PA work group, confirming current build scope for source/patient/structuredefinition-Patient.xml. Current source contains the corrected Patient.communication requirements text. Zulip and Confluence searches for FHIR-16607 and the Patient.communication grammar terms found no relevant or conflicting community record.
reconciliation: No source files were changed. The authoritative current Patient StructureDefinition already satisfies the Jira request, so this reconciliation published an empty no-change audit commit.
